text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer ran a blistering race in the 
Japanese Derby, sprinting past the finish 
line right at the very front.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rivals praise Mejiro Palmer, sending 
up a quiet chant of "Pal-mer!" in 
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, Daitaku Helios looked back on 
today's race and seemed to have come up 
with some kind of god-tier race plan.
